decisions.evidence: Independently read the entire current published corollary, its actual order/completeness/density interfaces, and the consumer's KL/f-divergence/convex-boundary prerequisite path. In Proof 6.1, s-s'=(s-a_k)+(a_k-b_k)+(b_k-s'). Replacing only the first and last summands by their absolute values gives the displayed upper bound, and a_k-b_k<=0 makes it <2 epsilon under the two convergence bounds. The negative middle term strengthens the estimate; it is not an absolute-value estimate on that term. Thus reader:12:1 is false_positive. No repair or published defect.
